purpose: Automatically preserve genuine GD Play check/preparation/handoff failure diagnostics without changing the displayed app result.
checks: Executed the actual disc_launch_failure_report and save_report functions extracted from main.c under ASan/UBSan.
All16 complete/passed/stopped/error flag combinations gate saving correctly; success, Stop and incomplete results acquire no SD storage.
Original app status bytes, error text, stage and last-read FAD remain unchanged, including failed/cancelled/unavailable report saves.
Storage double requires the worker busy, optical ownership released, no open files, no held mutex and balanced SD connect/disconnect.
Existing automatic-report policy clears an earlier operation Stop; a new B can cancel only report saving.
Worker routing asserts reports occur only after app return or after main frees the rejected handoff image and clears probe_launch_ready.
Prepared successful boot publishes and waits for main handoff before any possible report; no report runs on that success path.
limits: The new fixture executes report gating and formatting/cancellation/lifecycle with an authored SD/report-save double; it does not perform a real SD filesystem write.
Durable write/sync/close remains owned by existing kui_report_save; console scheduling, hardware I/O and physical fault recovery remain unverified.
A report-save failure is logged and allows manual retry; it does not replace the original GD Play result.
